name: Faith Without Deeds
overview: Scripture teaches that genuine faith is demonstrated through obedience and good works, as believers are called to let their light shine through their actions, glorifying God (Matthew 5:16). Simply professing faith or calling Jesus 'Lord' is insufficient without doing the will of the Father and keeping His commandments (Matthew 7:21; Luke 6:46; John 14:15). While justification comes by faith apart from the works of the law (Romans 3:28), the life of faith naturally produces deeds that reflect love and obedience, which will be evident when Christ returns in glory (Matthew 25:31).
